introHtml: Pink bar and wine gift sets add a playful, celebratory touch to any occasion. Whether you're planning a bachelorette party, a bridal shower, or a breast cancer awareness event, custom pink sets create a cohesive, memorable gift. The Sip and Step Gift Set, for example, combines a stemless wine glass with a pedicure kit in a matching pink box — ideal for spa-themed corporate gifts or event favors. Choose from screen printing or full-color wrap for your logo.
